boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain United States Merchant Marine Academy
boards.description: Ten nearby restaurants with current, directly published evening hours for an under-21-safe food outing from Kings Point.

cards.title: Cafe Muscat
cards.subtitle: 98 Cutter Mill Rd, Great Neck Plaza
cards.notes: Use the restaurant’s Great Neck ordering or reservation options for a late food stop; confirm the day’s service before leaving campus.
cards.short_summary: A kosher dairy restaurant with published late evening hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Cafe Muscat lists its Great Neck location at 98 Cutter Mill Rd and hours of 10am–11pm Monday through Thursday and Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Published hours: Monday–Thursday and Sunday, 10am–11pm. Verify holiday and Shabbat-related changes directly with the restaurant.

cards.title: Colbeh
cards.subtitle: 75 N. Station Plaza, Great Neck
cards.notes: Plan a Saturday evening meal here when the posted post-Shabbat service window fits; check the restaurant for that day’s opening time.
cards.short_summary: A Great Neck kosher Mediterranean restaurant with Saturday service listed through midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Colbeh lists its Great Neck address at 75 N. Station Plaza and Saturday hours from one hour after Shabbat until 12am.
cards.access_notes: Published Saturday hours run from one hour after Shabbat to 12am; service timing varies with Shabbat, so confirm before traveling.

cards.title: Pasha
cards.subtitle: 47 Middle Neck Rd, Great Neck
cards.notes: Reserve or call ahead for a Saturday dinner, then use the posted late window as a conservative planning reference for the trip.
cards.short_summary: A Great Neck restaurant whose official reservation page lists late Saturday hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Pasha lists 47 Middle Neck Rd, Great Neck, and Saturday opening hours of 8pm to 1am.
cards.access_notes: Published Saturday hours: 8pm–1am. Call ahead for seating and any special-event or holiday changes.

cards.title: La 420 Restaurant
cards.subtitle: 420 Northern Blvd, Great Neck
cards.notes: Choose a Friday or Saturday table for the latest listed food-service window, and confirm reservations or kitchen timing with the restaurant.
cards.short_summary: A Great Neck restaurant that lists midnight closing on Fridays and Saturdays.
cards.evidence_claim: La 420 Restaurant lists 420 Northern Blvd and Friday and Saturday hours ending at 12am.
cards.access_notes: Published hours: Friday 4:30pm–12am and Saturday 11:30am–12am. Confirm food availability and reservations before departure.

cards.title: Benihana Manhasset
cards.subtitle: 2105 Northern Blvd, Manhasset
cards.notes: Use the official reservation or online-ordering links to check availability, especially for Friday and Saturday dinner service.
cards.short_summary: A Manhasset hibachi and sushi restaurant with dining and takeout listed until 11pm on weekends.
cards.evidence_claim: Benihana lists its Manhasset location at 2105 Northern Blvd; dining and takeout are published until 11pm on Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Published Friday–Saturday hours: dining 11am–11pm and takeout/delivery 10:30am–11pm. Reservations may be needed.

cards.title: Bonsai Japanese Restaurant
cards.subtitle: 92 Main St, Port Washington
cards.notes: Order pickup or delivery through the restaurant’s official ordering page, using the Friday or Saturday takeout cutoff as the latest option.
cards.short_summary: A Port Washington Japanese restaurant with late Friday and Saturday takeout hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Bonsai Japanese Restaurant lists 92 Main St, Port Washington, with Friday and Saturday takeout hours ending at 11:15pm.
cards.access_notes: Published Friday hours: 11am–11:15pm; Saturday: 12pm–11:15pm. These are takeout hours; confirm pickup timing when ordering.

cards.title: Louie's Prime Steak & Seafood
cards.subtitle: 395 Main St, Port Washington
cards.notes: Make a Friday or Saturday reservation for a waterfront dinner, then confirm seating availability directly before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A Port Washington waterfront restaurant with Friday and Saturday service listed until 11pm.
cards.evidence_claim: Louie's lists its address as 395 Main St, Port Washington, and Friday and Saturday hours of 12pm–11pm.
cards.access_notes: Published Friday–Saturday hours: 12pm–11pm. The restaurant notes a smart-casual dress code; reservations are available online.

cards.title: JaydSiri Thai Bistro
cards.subtitle: 23 S Middle Neck Rd, Great Neck
cards.notes: Aim for Friday or Saturday dinner and arrive before the restaurant’s stated possible early end to guest seating.
cards.short_summary: A Great Neck Thai restaurant with dinner listed through 10:30pm on Fridays and Saturdays.
cards.evidence_claim: JaydSiri Thai Bistro lists 23 South Middle Neck Rd and Friday and Saturday dinner hours of 5pm–10:30pm.
cards.access_notes: Published Friday–Saturday dinner hours: 5pm–10:30pm. The restaurant says it may stop seating guests 30 minutes before closing.

cards.title: Golden Garden Restaurant
cards.subtitle: 150A Middle Neck Rd, Great Neck
cards.notes: Place a pickup or delivery order through the restaurant’s official site, leaving enough time before its published 10pm closing.
cards.short_summary: A Great Neck Chinese restaurant with daily service listed until 10pm.
cards.evidence_claim: Golden Garden Restaurant lists 150A Middle Neck Rd, Great Neck, and daily hours of 10:30am–10pm.
cards.access_notes: Published daily hours: 10:30am–10pm. The official site offers pickup and delivery ordering; confirm order cutoff before placing an order.

cards.title: Dagim Restaurant
cards.subtitle: 8 Bond St, Great Neck Plaza
cards.notes: Use Thursday’s published later closing for a dinner plan, and contact the restaurant before travel to confirm table or takeout timing.
cards.short_summary: A Great Neck Plaza restaurant with Thursday hours listed through 11pm.
cards.evidence_claim: Dagim Restaurant lists 8 Bond Street, Great Neck Plaza, and Thursday hours of 12:30pm–11pm.
cards.access_notes: Published Thursday hours: 12:30pm–11pm; other listed days close at 10pm, while Friday and Saturday are listed closed.
